description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core MVC controller for managing article-related HTTP endpoints within a web API. It includes actions for retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting articles, utilizing MediatR for request dispatching, and employs authorization attributes for secure endpoints.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller that handles HTTP requests related to articles, acting as an API endpoint with actions for CRUD operations and feeds.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of articles based on filters such as tag, author, favoriters, limit, and offset.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests for retrieving the personalized feed of articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for retrieving the details of a specific article identified by its slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article identified by its slug, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article identified by its slug, requiring authorization.
